title: Mayoi Neko Overrun! Specials
justification: AniList 8599 has 6 episodes (2010-06-25 to 2010-11-26; native 迷い猫ねこねこ劇場, synonym 'Stray Cats Cats Cats Theater'). AniDB 7229 S1-S6 are 'Stray Cats Theater 1..6' on 2010-06-25, 07-30, 08-27, 09-24, 10-29, 11-26, which is the same title meaning, the same count and every one of the six dates. TVDB 145231 season 0 holds 0x01-0x06 'Stray Cats Theater 1..6' with those six dates. S7 'SPATS MV' (undated) is not part of the entry. The current reason ('no title agrees') only compared 'Stray Cats Theater 1' with the AniList title string 'Mayoi Neko Overrun! Specials'; the content is the Neko-Neko theatre shorts and agrees.
